sw_gallery_guide.text: Fàilte! The arts centre. Music, film, a very good cafe. A ceilidh is a dance with a band, a caller who knows what he's doing, and a roomful of people who don't.

We have an exhibition of photographs from the herring days, when the whole of the harbour was full of boats and the whole of the quay was full of women gutting fish. The women were quicker than the machines and sang while they worked.
Oidhche mhath, if you're off: good night. Or stay for the cèilidh a-nochd, tonight, and say it at two in the morning instead.
